methodology.note: [sourced] Lacoste et al. 2019; hardware, runtime and grid based approximation.

[sourced] Authors' implementation; historical reference, not a current grid-factor authority.

pue.note: [inference] GPU-only baseline, no facility overhead assumed. Actual PUE is unknown. Replace with a documented facility-specific value before claiming facility emissions.

RTX 4090.note: [sourced] NVIDIA TGP; [inference] constant nameplate power, not metered draw.

A100 SXM 80GB.note: [sourced] Standard SXM configuration; excludes custom 500 W thermal SKU.

A100 PCIe 80GB.note: [sourced] 80GB PCIe model; not interchangeable with SXM or 40GB.

FR.note: [sourced] France consumption intensity including exchanges, 20.0 gCO2e/kWh; direct operational emissions.

US-ERCT.note: [sourced] EPA ERCT 736.629 lb CO2e/MWh; multiply by 0.45359237 / 1000. Assign only after verifying facility grid.

US-CAMX.note: [sourced] EPA CAMX 429.983 lb CO2e/MWh; multiply by 0.45359237 / 1000. Assign only after verifying facility grid.

US.note: [sourced] EPA U.S. national 770.884 lb CO2e/MWh, converted with 0.45359237 / 1000. [inference] Coarse national fallback for explicitly mapped U.S. facilities; not a measured facility or state intensity.
